name: pi-permission-system
notes: Forked from gotgenes/pi-packages; wrapper-floor rework (fallback mode) intentionally diverges from upstream — behavior contract lives in the bash-wrapper-floors spec.

knownDebt.reason: Generated artifact: `pnpm run gen:schema` (scripts/generate-permissions-schema.ts) rewrites this file and then runs `biome format --write`, whose default indentation is tabs, while upstream ships 2-space. The tab indentation is produced by the generator, not by hand-reformatting; re-running gen:schema re-applies it.

reapplyOnSync: makeCommandUnit keeps fork classifyWrapperCommand emission (wrapper + inner units), upstream home/argument spellings and floorExemptionOf against redirectedScope(node, scope); classification receives the upstream WordReader to recognize literal quoted sudo names; collectTimedSubshell emits its already-descended subshell once without an extra fork wrapper inner unit

collectCommands retains upstream (node, words, speller) arguments and accepts a fourth options.parseProgram argument for the fork payload parser; BashProgram.build and wrapper-parse carry it through both asynchronous and synchronous parsing
wrapper-floors innerCommandText slices the inner unit from word-joined, heredoc-body-free unit text by mapping the inner token offset through wrapper args rather than node.text.slice(start)
program.test.ts and program-parse-sync.test.ts expectations retain fork wrapper_payload/wrapper_indirection units beside upstream command spellings, heredoc/redirect and salvaged cases

bash-command-metamorphic.test.ts retains conservative inner-unit denies for computed timeout payloads that upstream only floors to ask; composition-root.test.ts explicitly selects always for the wrapper-floor forwarding case because fork config defaults to fallback

permission-manager.ts keeps dual-layer profile scopes, invalidProfileName and warnings beside upstream legacyMcpToolKeys relocation; getPolicyIssues returns profile diagnostics through the upstream PolicyIssueReporter
schemas/permissions.schema.json is regenerated with pnpm run gen:schema over fork schema sources; generator tab indentation is declared knownDebt

test/path/native-tool-target.test.ts and test/path/path-flavor.test.ts deep-import hoisted dependencies through ../../../../node_modules/... rather than the upstream package-local ../../node_modules/... path

resolveWrapperUnit keeps the fork fallback option and uses upstream floorToAsk so unresolved fallback asks carry floor/askingUnits through forwarding; advisory checks pass wrapperFloors after the new PathNormalizer argument

wrapper-analysis.ts exports innerCommandIndex with an optional allowEmpty=false parameter carried into getoptInnerIndex; fork classifySudo reuses that grammar with allowEmpty=true so rejected syntax floors while legal payload-less invocations remain inert; quote removal is per literal CommandWord.value while source offsets/text remain unchanged, and recognized indirection chains carry refused sudo floors and correctly located sudo inner units
bash-command.test.ts expects explicit inner rm denies to outrank the outer floor for correctly parsed sudo --user/-nu cases; program.test.ts keeps refused sudo compound syntax unresolved
doNotReintroduce: do not re-inline the wrapper-classification block into command-enumeration.ts on sync
do not let biome/prettier reformat upstream files in this package: upstream-owned regions are 2-space, fork-authored regions stay tab-indented
do not adopt upstream release-number CHANGELOG sections; keep the independent fork release sections
do not restore the old sync-commands parser: upstream BashProgram.parseSync and its shared builder retain the fork payload parser
do not restore blanket always-mode flooring for proven execution modifiers; both modes retain upstream core-reader and execution-modifier exemptions
do not restore the fork sudo value-options table or allow refused/unknown sudo modes through fallback; classifySudo reuses upstream grammar and floors unresolved forms
